decisionsTitle: The share row and the calendar pill on one line, the doors in a dropdown
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-15, from the event page after the calendar fold (§772):** «These should be inline to save space» — «Dă mai departe: Distribuie, Facebook, WhatsApp, Descarcă poza» sat on one line and «Adaugă în calendar» alone on the next.

**Decision (amends §767 and §772).** One wrapping flex row, eight pixels between pills: the caption, the networks and, last, the «Adaugă în calendar» pill, all the same 28-pixel pill with its non-overlapping tap band. The pill stays the `<summary>` of a native `<details>`; its body — the five doors in §767's order and words, the file's note and the file-address fold — is now a dropdown panel under the pill: absolutely placed, so opening it moves no pill and the row does not grow. The row is the panel's containing block; the panel is 26rem at most and never wider than the row, its own surface (`DROPDOWN_PANEL_SURFACE_SX`, shared with the calendar page's help panel: `background.paper`, `divider`), border and shadow from theme tokens, above the page's content and above the footer's bar (z-index 1001; the header is above it). Its left edge is the pill's, pulled back so its right edge never passes the row's: inside the viewport at 320 pixels whichever line the pill wrapped to. A bare `<summary>` is content-box where MUI's button is border-box, so the pill read 34 pixels beside its 28-pixel neighbours; it is border-box now.

**Scripts off.** The panel is plain CSS: it opens with the pill (click, Enter, Space), flows out of the row the same way, closes with the pill, and stays inside the row's width (the left edge is then the row's own). **With scripts**, the one small client island `CalendarFoldClose` (it draws nothing; the house had no dropdown behaviour to reuse — the existing `details` islands only open folds) adds Escape (focus back on the pill when it was inside the panel) and a click outside, and writes the pill's offset into a custom property on the row (`--calendar-pill-left`, kept current by a ResizeObserver and a MutationObserver for the phone's share button, which arrives after hydration) so the panel sits under the pill.

**Left as it was.** The doors' addresses and how they open, the share actions, the file's note and the file-address fold, every string (no catalogue key added), the members' event (the calendar pill alone in the row, no caption). **Known and accepted:** at 320 pixels the panel's inner width is a little under the longest door's word, so «Outlook la serviciu sau la școală» takes two lines in the panel (the closed pills are all 28 pixels).

**Refused.** A MUI `Menu`/`Popover` (a client tree and focus trap for a list of links), CSS anchor positioning as the only mechanism (not everywhere yet; the variable works in every browser), a panel anchored to the row's left edge alone (far from the pill on a wide screen).
changelogLine: - **The share row and «Adaugă în calendar» on one line** — the calendar pill is the row's last pill, and its five doors open as a dropdown under it that moves nothing; Escape or a click outside closes it (a click, not a pointer press: a scroll swipe that starts outside leaves it open). §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 48: on an event page the caption, the networks and the «Adaugă în calendar» pill are ONE wrapping row of the same 28-pixel pill, the calendar pill last; its fold's body — the five doors, the file's note and the file's address fold — is a dropdown panel under the pill, out of the flow, so opening it moves no pill and does not grow the row; Escape and a click outside close it where scripts run, and with scripts off it opens and closes by the pill (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Tested in tests/unit/events/share-row-calendars.test.ts and tests/e2e/share-links.spec.ts.

Amends criteria 233 and 234: at 320 pixels the one share row wraps with the calendar pill in it, and the open calendar panel stays inside the page, nothing wider than the viewport, its doors small pills (the longest may take two lines there); no pill moves when the panel opens (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Tested in tests/e2e/share-links.spec.ts.
